cases.evidence: Exactly seven production RBAC roles are contract-bound.
Cross-tenant project IDs did not disclose data or existence markers.
Approved command, audit, outbox, and idempotency persisted together.
Duplicate command replay did not duplicate canonical writes.
Outbox used the approved server-side version snapshot, not client payload.
Signed URL resolved only with bound tenant/project/user/hash claims.
A stale outbox lock was reclaimed after worker restart.
Duplicate event delivery executed one consumer side effect.
Canonical command and signed artifact access both emitted actor audit rows.
A0 through A5 have versioned canonical production adapters; A4 stays read-only.
